# GitHub Discussions Setup Guide

GitHub Discussions must be enabled manually through the GitHub web interface. Follow these steps:

## How to Enable GitHub Discussions

1. **Go to your repository on GitHub:**
   - Navigate to: https://github.com/jaydubya818/baseline-project

2. **Access Settings:**
   - Click on the "Settings" tab (top right of the repository page)
   - You need admin access to the repository to see this tab

3. **Enable Discussions:**
   - Scroll down to the "Features" section
   - Check the box next to "Discussions"
   - Click "Set up discussions" if prompted

4. **Configure Discussion Categories:**
   Once enabled, set up these recommended categories:

   ### 📋 Recommended Categories:

   **General**
   - 💬 **General** - General discussions about the toolkit
   - 📢 **Announcements** - Project updates and announcements (maintainers only)
   - 💡 **Ideas** - Share ideas and suggestions
   - 🙏 **Q&A** - Ask and answer questions

   **Development**
   - 🤖 **AI Agents** - Discuss AI agents, share configurations
   - 🎓 **Claude Skills** - Discuss Claude skills, share experiences
   - 🔧 **Workflows** - Share and discuss development workflows
   - 🛠️ **Taskmaster** - Taskmaster integration and usage

   **Community**
   - 📚 **Show and Tell** - Share what you've built with the toolkit
   - 🎯 **Use Cases** - Discuss different use cases and applications
   - 🤝 **Help Wanted** - Ask for help or offer to help others
   - 🌟 **Success Stories** - Share your success stories

5. **Customize Welcome Message:**
   Create a pinned welcome post with:
   ```markdown
   # Welcome to Baseline Project Discussions! 🎉

   This is the place to:
   - Ask questions about the AI Development Toolkit
   - Share how you're using the agents and skills
   - Discuss ideas for improvements
   - Help others in the community
   - Show off what you've built

   ## Getting Started
   - New here? Read the [README](../README.md) and [DISCLAIMER](../DISCLAIMER.md)
   - Have a question? Check the Q&A category
   - Want to contribute? See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
   - Found a bug? [Create an issue](../issues/new/choose)

   ## Community Guidelines
   - Be respectful and constructive
   - Search before posting to avoid duplicates
   - Use appropriate categories for your posts
   - Help others when you can

   Happy discussing! 🚀
   ```

## Verification

Once enabled, you should see:
- A "Discussions" tab in your repository navigation
- Discussion categories as configured
- Ability to create new discussions

## Benefits of GitHub Discussions

- **Community Building** - Foster a community around the toolkit
- **Knowledge Base** - Build a searchable archive of Q&A
- **Feedback Loop** - Gather feedback and ideas from users
- **Support** - Provide a place for users to help each other
- **Announcements** - Share updates and news with the community

## Integration with Issues

Use this guide to decide between Discussions vs Issues:

### Use Discussions For:
- ✅ Questions ("How do I...?")
- ✅ Ideas and brainstorming
- ✅ General discussions
- ✅ Sharing experiences
- ✅ Community help

### Use Issues For:
- ✅ Bug reports
- ✅ Feature requests with clear scope
- ✅ Documentation errors
- ✅ Specific, actionable items

## Next Steps

After enabling Discussions:

1. **Create Welcome Post** - Pin a welcome message
2. **Seed Initial Discussions** - Create a few starter discussions
3. **Update README** - Add link to Discussions
4. **Monitor & Engage** - Respond to discussions regularly
5. **Moderate** - Keep discussions on-topic and respectful
